typography.headingCharacter: very large bold geometric/grotesk sans, mixed case, tight tracking, letters overlapped by other collage elements
typography.bodyCharacter: small all-caps nav labels with wide letter-spacing and light weight; plain sans body copy in the cookie modal at moderate size and leading

composition.structure: asymmetric scrapbook collage: a giant centered wordmark anchors overlapping photos, stickers and 3D letterforms scattered at varied angles around a slim top nav

spacing.rhythm: no visible grid; objects are placed and rotated ad hoc like a corkboard, with only the top nav row keeping conventional alignment

surfaceTreatment.finish: glossy inflated 3D typography and crumpled-paper stickers mixed with plain matte photographs and flat cream background

imagery.treatment: collaged photos (macro eye, monochrome dolmen, vintage family snapshot, coastline) mixed with glossy inflated 3D letterforms and doodle marks, each tilted independently with drop shadows

motion.character: elements enter with an ease-out spring-like lift (preBrandUp, ~0.9s), hover swaps background/border-color over ~0.25-0.5s, an infinite 36s linear marquee runs unprompted, scroll drives parallax and reveal fades
motion.choreography: hero artifacts pre-animate upward on load, then scroll reveals fire at several distinct depths (sequenced, not simultaneous) alongside parallax on roughly a third of tracked elements and a sticky/resizing header; motion is measurably reduced under prefers-reduced-motion

philosophy.text: The page stages brand identity as a physical corkboard rather than a digital layout: inflated glossy letterforms, sun-faded snapshots and a wax-seal sticker are pinned around a single oversized wordmark, trading grid discipline and clean hierarchy for the texture of a collected, tactile archive. A single orange accent and the giant black wordmark keep the clutter from reading as noise. That looseness is load-bearing rather than decorative — scroll-triggered reveals stagger in at different depths and parallax nudges roughly a third of the tracked elements, so the collage assembles itself progressively as you move down the page instead of arriving all at once, with the motion budget scaled back under reduced-motion preference.

build.techniques: Spring-eased hero sequence on load with staggered element lifts; scroll-triggered parallax depth reveals (sequential layered fades at ~3 distinct depths); infinite linear marquee loop via GSAP timeline; 3D letterform rendering with PBR materials/shadow maps for glossy realism; sticky header with dynamic height shrink on scroll (CSS + scroll listener); collision-aware z-index layering to preserve overlap order across tilted collage elements
